name: Radar.initialize
author: akano12
description: Radar (radar.io) tracks the location of the device for the app, also in the background. Its initialize methods are skipped, so its methods do nothing, like before the app initializes it; its receivers and job, which initialize it themselves for background locations, are skipped too. Install all Radar definitions. For Radar 3 and later (io.radar.sdk); the definitions of the former package com.onradar.sdk were removed.

-- The method is skipped, with the result of its return type (see the definition): false for a boolean method,
-- like a registration, 0 for a method returning a result code, of which 0 means success, nothing for a void method.
-- A Boolean is false too, because callers which unbox it would fail on null, like Clarity.initialize.

function before(hook, param)
    local returnType = hook:getReturnType()
    if returnType == 'boolean' or returnType == 'java.lang.Boolean' then
        param:setResult(false)
    elseif returnType == 'int' then
        param:setResult(0)
    else
        param:setResult(nil)
    end
    return true
end
